procedural_matters: LTU 444 did not present a good reason to extend the time limit.
LTU 444 failed to inform the RC about her intention to protest at the finishing line immediately after finishing, as required by NoR 1.4.
Fiorella Nicolari, Ezio Fonda, Marin Kustic, members of the international jury, attended the hearing as observers.
decision: The Protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
